label: soco54 marginal gas basis
definition: SOCO-54: gas_plant_monthly_fuel_pricing turned OFF against the SOCO-53f keeper recipe — the field's own SHIPPED DEFAULT, which SOCO had inherited ON — so every SOCO gas unit prices on the realized Henry Hub level plus SOCO's own measured EIA-923 delivered-gas basis (GAS_BASIS_DIFFERENTIAL['SOCO'] = 0.64, registered by SOCO-20 from those same receipts) instead of each plant's own monthly delivered-CONTRACT print. A dispatch offer is a MARGINAL cost and the print is an AVERAGE DELIVERED CONTRACT cost, so this is rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]'s misalignment clause and the swap is measured-to-measured. The basis is MEASURED, not argued: eight SOCO plants file ONE common monthly shape x a plant-constant multiplier in all three years at ratio CV <= 0.00081, and the multipliers REPRICE with no physical cause — Yates (728) goes 1.8279 -> 1.1669 -> 0.7959 against Hartwell (54538), whose own 2023 print sits BELOW Henry Hub in 11 of 12 months, which no DELIVERED gas can do; the model burned 4x-160x the gas these plants procured. ZERO ScenarioConfig fields and ZERO free parameters added (DOF 3 entries / 1 residual, unchanged). Rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] at two grains: only the six GAS classes move on fuel_prices and mc_base, with coal, oil, nuclear, hydro, wind, solar and biomass at max |delta| exactly 0.000000000000 in all three years — a marginal-COST statement; coal DISPATCH does move as a second-order effect (2023 COAL_PRB +1.481 TWh, toward its actual). WHAT IT DELIVERS: the outgoing keeper's single failing C1 row — 2023 CT_PEAKER at +9.73 TWh / +4.0pp — closes to +6.13 TWh / +2.55pp against a +/-3.00pp cap, a full C1 PASS at 14/14 on the committed bench; C2 / C4 / C6 / C8 PASS, 0 ledgered and 0 protective caveats. THE HEADLINE IS BENCH-DEPENDENT AND METRICS.JSON IS THE AUTHORITY: 2024 CC_REGULAR lands at +7.417 TWh against a +/-7.47 band on the committed bench (a 0.05 TWh pass) and at +7.505 on a freshly rebuilt one (a fail) — the row PRECOMMIT-soco-54 P4 pre-registered as this arm's stated risk at 81 % of its margin. 2023 CT_PEAKER closes on BOTH benches. Reported against the run: 55061 Tenaska Georgia is made worse (1.412 -> 2.690 TWh against a 0.237 actual), 2049 Jack Watson moves the wrong way (2.355 -> 1.256 against 3.270), and 728 Yates improves 13x while still sitting at 36 % of its actual. SOCO has NO price benchmark and never will, so C3a / C3b / C3c are UNSCORABLE, not failed, and no price level, shape or tail is certified. Evidence: docs/handoffs/FINDING-soco-54-2026-09-20.md.
